mode.description: The single public skill mode selected from the request. Use select only for graph-versus-loop decisions or scope/artifact classification; an explicit request to design a new workflow uses design.

artifact.description: The public artifact returned by that mode.

decision.description: Use graph for a new design, existing_graph for compile/audit/diagnose/optimize, candidate_graph only for persistent evolution of an existing graph, out_of_scope for excluded GraphRAG or graph-database work, and no_graph_artifact only when the request asks whether supplied material is itself a graph artifact (a diagram, ordinary program, or informal conversation without all four conditions) or the material carries no graph identity; a run trace that names its graph id and version is diagnosed against that graph (existing_graph).
